name: Tinker Bell
source:
A fairy of Neverland.

The younger sister of Tink and is friendly with her brother. It’s unsure where her true intentions lie.

She’s fond of Peter and is very agreeable towards him. When she’s with him, she’s never bored. She dotes very much upon the adult Peter who’s quite like a child.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at Livejournal[/url]]
